text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is here. With the Kikuka Sho approaching, Mejiro Bright and I discuss how we should approach her upcoming training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since it's a long-distance race, I suggest we ask an Umamusume with experience in that category to coach her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the plan decided, our days of blazing hot training begin.
